description: 首版场景分类体系。新增或改名必须提升 taxonomy_version 并重新分桶。

labels.label: portrait
labels.description: A person or a small group is the primary subject; faces or bodies dominate the frame.

labels.label: natural_landscape
labels.description: Outdoor natural scenery dominates: mountains, water, forest, sky, fields, coastline.

labels.label: urban_architecture
labels.description: Buildings, structures, interiors of public architecture, or city geometry dominate.

labels.label: street_documentary
labels.description: Candid everyday urban life, pedestrians, markets, transient observed moments.

labels.label: indoor
labels.description: Domestic or enclosed interior scenes where the room itself is the subject.

labels.label: still_life
labels.description: Arranged objects, food, products or tabletop compositions.

labels.label: other
labels.description: None of the registered labels fit, or the scene is ambiguous. Never forms a formal style bucket.
